about: Nightly re-read of the regulators’ registers behind the CRYPTO STATEMENTS Exchange Register. rows[exchange|register|entity].date is the last day the row was found on the regulator’s own page; missing_since marks a row not found, for a person to check. Nothing is removed or relabelled automatically.
